title: Sticky Question: Paper Chromatography
description: An inquiry-centered Chemistry Paper Chromatography workflow that preserves five source-listed solvent choices while running one configured water/2-propanol comparison with traceable sample provenance, physically valid chromatography geometry, measured Rf evidence, solvent-specific disposal, and explicit interpretation limits.
learningGoals: Design a repeatable paper chromatography comparison using an intermolecular-force hypothesis and at least two source-listed mobile phases.
Prepare, spot, dry, seal, develop, mark, observe, and measure a paper chromatogram using physically valid origin and solvent geometry.
Calculate Rf from recorded band and solvent-front distances with appropriate significant figures.
Compare solvent-dependent separation and green-chemistry evidence without treating Rf as proof of molecular identity.
safetyNotes: Wear splash-proof goggles before handling any solution or solvent.
Wash solution contact from skin with copious water and follow teacher-configured handling restrictions.
Keep ignition sources disabled when flammable organic solvents are present.
Keep the chromatography chamber closed during development to limit evaporation.
Route distilled-water/food-dye waste to the teacher-approved sink stream; collect acetone, ethanol, 2-propanol, and chromatography solvent as organic waste.
